claims.statement: EU enterprise AI use rose 6.5 percentage points to 20% in 2025, while Poland reached only 8.4%; finance, accounting, controlling, and administration are already reported AI use cases.
Polish service SMEs currently allocate paid staff time to inbox classification, document extraction, quoting, scheduling, and invoice processing; hours per firm require direct measurement.
The likely payer is the owner-manager using payroll or outsourced-administration budget, but low Polish adoption may reflect weak willingness or capability.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Microsoft, Google, CRM, and accounting suites can bundle assistants; vertical workflow ownership and outcome guarantees provide resistance
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown today; proposed direct contracts with one narrow Polish service vertical
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Trade software resellers, accountants, family-business referrals under explicit agreement, and targeted outbound

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Setup paid upfront and monthly retainer in advance
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 55-70% after monitoring and human exception handling
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Assumption: 20-60 hours initial workflow mapping and 2-6 hours monthly support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: GDPR, AI policy, security, liability, and vendor subscriptions
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Setup plus monthly managed automation pod
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Model inference, automation platforms, monitoring, and exception labor

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Horizontal productivity suites improve agents and local resellers offer implementation
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Current employee or outsourced-admin hours spent moving information among email, documents, calendars, quotes, and invoices
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Hiring avoidance, backlog, staff departure, or repeated administrative error
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly if documented hours saved exceed fee

contrary_evidence: Poland's low adoption may signal limited demand rather than untapped opportunity.
Horizontal AI suites are improving rapidly and can compress service margins.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed workflow-integration agreement covering selected inbox, CRM, calendar, and accounting actions; unsigned
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Deliver an offline process audit and human-operated prototype using customer-provided sample data
critical_control_point.current_owner: Each SME and its software vendors control workflow data and action permissions
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Unknown today; proposed direct contracts with one narrow Polish service vertical
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: A family-business relationship may allow a formally consented renewable-installer pilot, but no customer data or employer materials are presently usable
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business after scoped authorization; customer retains approval for high-risk actions
critical_control_point.subject: Vertical administrative workflow integration

economics.acquisition_route: Choose one workflow in renewable installers, baseline hours for four weeks, deploy human-in-loop automation, then clone to ten firms
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: productizing to 500 firms at 3,000 PLN monthly yields 18m PLN ARR; at 15-25% owner earnings, founder net worth can exceed 5m PLN in 4-7 years. Support intensity and vertical concentration are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 20-25 hours weekly until standardized onboarding and support hires exist
economics.gross_margin_basis: Monthly fee less model, automation, monitoring, and human exception costs
economics.payback: Assumption: 3-6 months at 4,000 PLN CAC and 1,000-1,500 PLN monthly contribution
economics.pricing: Assumption: 5,000-20,000 PLN setup plus 1,500-5,000 PLN monthly
economics.retention_or_repeat: Monthly while workflows remain active and savings are evidenced

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Vertical process templates, exception data, and time-saving benchmarks
fingerprint.customer: Small Polish installation or field-service businesses
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Owner pays to replace measurable administrative labor and backlog
fingerprint.problem_trigger: AI use is rising but Polish SME adoption remains unusually low

founder_fit: Directly uses AI, data science, and workflow automation.
A renewable-installer vertical can be tested through lawful family-company cooperation.
Can bootstrap within 100,000 PLN and validate before leaving employment.
risks: Custom implementation can become a low-margin agency.
Sensitive email and finance access increases security exposure.
Platform vendors may commoditize core functions.

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: vertical human in loop administrative automation
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: email crm calendar and accounting apis

structure.critical_dependency: Stable integrations and provable labor savings

thesis: Rapid EU AI adoption alongside Poland's low base creates a service-to-software window for outcome-priced vertical administration automation.
title: AI Admin Pods for Polish Field-Service SMEs
uncertainties: Low adoption's true cause is unknown.
Hours saved and acceptable error rates are unknown.
How quickly the service can standardize is unknown.
